newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Trains collide in Luxembourg, at least one dead.
newsitem.headline: Trains collide in Luxembourg, at least one dead.

text.p: A passenger and a freight train collided in Luxembourg on Sunday morning, killing at least one person and injuring 31, a police spokesman said.
A railways spokesman said the accident happened at around 6.40 a.m. (0440 GMT) as the passenger train was leaving Luxembourg city to travel towards Bettembourg to the south.
The trains collided about one and a half km (one mile) outside the city station. The injured were taken to hospitals in Luxembourg and Esch-zur-Alzette, the police said.
The accident blocked the main line to the south and international trains from Italy, Switzerland and France had to be diverted to Arlon in neighbouring Belgium.
The cause of the accident was not immediately known, the railways spokesman said. "There has to be an inquiry," he said.
